function_question: How does nature stay on top of water?

opening.text: There was a boy called Max who lived in a small village at the edge of a thick jungle.
Max walked 3 hours to school, because a huge river cut right across his path and the only way was the long way round.
Max stopped on the riverbank and thought:

thought.big: What if I could cross right here?
thought.small: School would be minutes away, not hours!

card.place: A huge river in the jungle

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: A big idea on the riverbank
chapters.line: Max stops at the water and wonders: what if I could cross right here?

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Max asks for help
chapters.line: Max has lots of questions, and he needs a teammate. What about you?

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The nature heroes
chapters.line: You and Max go down to the water to meet animals and plants that never sink.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The secret of floating
chapters.line: The heroes share the secret they all use.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Training in the clay lab
chapters.line: Every hero needs training. Max hands you a lump of clay.

chapters.label: Chapter 5½
chapters.title: The idea storm
chapters.line: Ideas start swirling like leaves on the wind!

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The plan
chapters.line: Every great crossing starts as a drawing.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The big test
chapters.line: The first try wobbles. You fix it, and try again.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: Max crosses the river
chapters.line: Max crosses in minutes and walks into school on time.

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Max has started thinking about what he could do. What about you? Can you help him? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of an idea. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature solved this millions of years ago. Tap each card to meet four nature heroes who never sink!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which boat shape will hold the most coins?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your crossing like a real engineer!
guide.build_and_test: Build your model and let's see how many coins Max's crossing can carry!
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE thing and test again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, Max crosses the river on YOUR crossing. He gets to school in minutes, and his whole village wants one too!

quick_check.question: Crossing the river takes 10 minutes. How much time does Max save each morning?
quick_check.right: Right! That's almost 6 hours a day there and back: time for football, reading or sleep!
quick_check.wrong: Not quite. Try 3 hours take away 10 minutes.

clue_cards.name: Water strider
clue_cards.trick: Long legs covered in tiny waxy hairs.
clue_cards.does: Spreads its weight so it stands on the water's skin without breaking it.

clue_cards.name: Fire ants
clue_cards.trick: They link their bodies into a living raft.
clue_cards.does: Air trapped between them keeps the colony afloat for days.

clue_cards.name: Giant water lily
clue_cards.trick: A huge leaf with a rim and air-filled ribs underneath.
clue_cards.does: It floats even with a small child sitting on it.

clue_cards.name: Coconut
clue_cards.trick: A thick, hairy husk full of air.
clue_cards.does: Floats across oceans for months and keeps the seed dry.

predict.explain: Same steel, different shape. The ship is wide and hollow, so it pushes aside lots of water.

define_problem.popi: Let's be problem detectives! Answer the 6 big questions, Who, What, Where, When, Why and How, to define Max's problem.
define_problem.title: The big question
define_problem.question: What exactly is the problem?
define_problem.hint: Answer each question in a few words.

prompts.label: Who
prompts.question: Who has a problem in our story?
prompts.hint: Look at the pictures: who is the boy with the backpack?

prompts.label: What
prompts.question: What does Max need to do?
prompts.hint: Max wants to get to the other side of something big… what is it?

prompts.label: Where
prompts.question: Where does Max need to cross?
prompts.example: The big river in the jungle
prompts.hint: Look at picture 3: what is Max sitting next to?

prompts.label: When
prompts.question: When does Max have this problem?
prompts.example: Every day, on his way to school
prompts.hint: Look at picture 2: how often does Max walk to school?

prompts.label: Why
prompts.question: Why is this a big problem for Max?
prompts.example: The long way round takes 3 hours
prompts.hint: How long does Max walk to school the long way?

prompts.label: How

prompts.example: Build a light raft or a bridge
